symbols.name: butterfly map
symbols.meaning: The butterfly map $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$ applied to a pair of records.
symbols.quote: Fast simultaneous butterfly layers is a fixed-tape procedure that applies $H_0(u,v)=((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$ to one bit position in several address chunks at once.

symbols.name: chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected address chunks.
symbols.quote: Let $\Delta$ be the number of selected address chunks

symbols.name: chunk bound
symbols.meaning: An upper bound on the chunk count, so that the chunk count is at most d; on the recursive-power-saving page the letter d means the axis-count parameter.
symbols.quote: and let $d$ be an upper bound on $\Delta$

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of consecutive address bits in one address chunk.
symbols.quote: Each chunk consists of $\chi$ consecutive address bits

symbols.name: layer exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent below 1 in the layer's cost bound.
symbols.quote: The layer costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ for a fixed exponent $\lambda'<1$

symbols.name: bit-flip matrix
symbols.meaning: The 2-by-2 matrix that swaps the two entries of a pair.

symbols.name: phase matrix
symbols.meaning: The diagonal matrix diag(1, i), which multiplies the second entry of a pair by i.

symbols.name: two-point kernel
symbols.meaning: The 2-by-2 matrix one half times (1+i)I plus (1-i)Y, the kernel applied to each pair.

symbols.name: child-call count
symbols.meaning: The number of child calls into which one node of the recursion reduces its group of selected chunks.
symbols.quote: The phase identities for $\Xi$ reduce this group to $s$ child calls, each computing $\Xi^{\otimes f}$ on one slot, with $s<Wm$.

symbols.name: fixed exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent $1-2^{-50}$ bounding s/W by a power of m; on the recursive-power-saving page the letter sigma means the leaf exponent.

relations.quote: The layer gets its exponent from [Recursive power saving from s<Wm](recursive-power-saving.md), which turns such a recursion into a power saving.
The layer moves whole chunks by [Fast interchange of address fields](fast-address-interchange.md) to realize its binary basis changes.
The layer performs the butterfly rounds of [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md), which otherwise needs one whole-array pass per butterfly.

relations.quote: This single truncation keeps error within the bound of [Fixed-point precision and exact recovery](fixed-point-precision.md), which needs error below $1/2$.
